progression.narrative: The performance opens on Cs3 and dwells most on C in Reng-e Shahr-ashub. The line peaks at Ds5 (586.4 Hz) at 11:43.0. It closes on Fk4, not the tonic (G4 → Fk4 → Fk4 → Fk4 → Fk4 → Fk4).
